title: Bal Thackeray photo row: Shiv Sena (UBT) workers protest against Shaina NC in Mumbai

ai.summary: Shiv Sena (UBT) workers protested in Mumbai against Shaina NC, demanding an FIR after she allegedly tore a photo of Bal Thackeray during a political demonstration. Police detained several protesters and deployed heavily to prevent incidents.

facts.claim: hundreds of Shiv Sena (UBT) workers took to the streets in Mumbai to protest against Shaina NC
facts.quote: hundreds of Shiv Sena (UBT) workers took to the streets in Mumbai to protest against Shaina NC

facts.claim: protesters gathered outside Sena Bhavan in Dadar
facts.quote: gathered outside Sena Bhavan in Dadar, the headquarters of the Uddhav Thackeray-led Shiv Sena (UBT)

facts.claim: Several protesters were later detained by police
facts.quote: Several protesters were later detained by police, an official said.

facts.claim: Heavy police deployment was seen outside the premises to prevent any untoward incident
facts.quote: Heavy police deployment was seen outside the premises to prevent any untoward incident and maintain law and order.

facts.claim: Shaina NC apologised for her actions
facts.quote: Shaina NC apologised for her actions on Thursday, saying she was sorry if they had inadvertently hurt the sentiments of genuine Shiv Sainiks or admirers of Bal Thackeray.

facts.claim: Shaina later took to X to defend herself
facts.quote: Shaina later took to X to defend herself, claiming that she had torn the image of Congress leader Mani Shankar Aiyar and not Bal Thackeray.

ai.background_note: Shiv Sena (UBT) workers protested in Mumbai against Shaina NC after she allegedly tore a photo of Bal Thackeray during a political demonstration, leading to demands for an FIR and police detentions.
